description: This file defines a mock class GstWrapperMock for testing, which implements the IGstWrapper interface. It includes mock methods for various GStreamer-related functions, and provides helper functions to create and set GstCaps and GstStructure objects with different data types. The class is used within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace and is intended for unit testing GStreamer wrapper functionalities.

classes.name: GstWrapperMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IGstWrapper interface for testing GStreamer wrapper functions.

methods.name: gstCapsNewSimple
methods.description: Creates a new GstCaps object with a specified media type and a variable list of properties with their types and values.

methods.name: gstCapsSetSimple
methods.description: Sets multiple properties on a GstCaps object using a variable argument list, handling different GType data types.

methods.name: gstStructureNew
methods.description: Creates a new GstStructure with a specified name and a variable list of properties with their types and values.

methods.name: gstStructureSet
methods.description: Sets multiple fields on a GstStructure using a variable argument list, handling string and uint types.
